name: usage-batteries
description:
Show always-visible Claude usage meters in the status line as horizontal phone batteries.

Fill is remaining (100 minus used). The cluster grows or shrinks with the meters that are on and have data.

status line; commands: /usage-batteries-install, /usage-fable-off, /usage-fable-on, /usage-labels-off, /usage-labels-on, /usage-session-off, /usage-session-on, /usage-weekly-off, /usage-weekly-on; SessionStart hook.
